about.text: The particular American variety of Mozzarella with a stringy texture

sources.text: Fibrous, low-salt cheese from East Anatolia (Kars, Erzurum), curd scalded in hot water and stretched; sold and eaten fresh (keeps up to ~10 days). A lab study ripened it 90 days, but that is not the normal product
